iyw09l9 The APXS is at the back. Turn until your back faces Barnacle Bill and approach in reverse.
k76gk3v The APXS found more silica in Barnacle Bill than in the soil around it.
fz849jb Barnacle Bill was the first rock Sojourner analyzed: it was just a few steps from the module.
pcxcfiu Reach the rock
ilkm6op and analyze it.
p2zqvcs According to the data, Yogi looked like a basalt, although a layer of dust may have affected the measurement.
4xgk665 The team named many rocks after cartoon characters, like Yogi and Scooby-Doo.
809wwwd , the farthest rock of the day.
axd6jns Scooby-Doo is far away and surrounded by rocks. If you run out of commands, send them in two parts.
bcspcmz Scooby-Doo seemed to be made of compacted soil.
4g1lrfy In its first seven days, Sojourner worked about 10 m from the module. Its radio reached about 100 m, but everything it sent went through Pathfinder.

4ldcrak Commands sent today:
hluc8xu Commands travel to Mars by radio. During the mission they took 10 to 15 minutes to arrive; here we speed it up.
k2wkcud Sojourner stopped: there it would have left the work zone near the module (12 m in the game).
w65xv94 Sojourner stopped: the Pathfinder module was in the way.
zaosyhd Sojourner's lasers detected a rock and stopped it. The remaining commands were canceled.
x1xng4q The APXS didn't touch any rock. Remember: it's at the back and has to end up right against the target rock.
d961tpa Sojourner finished your commands and is waiting for the next ones. You can continue from here.

=Tu nombre => Your name
=Pathfinder => Pathfinder
=Módulo Pathfinder => Pathfinder module
=Quitar => Remove
=Girar izq. => Turn left
=Girar der. => Turn right
=Ver tutorial => Watch tutorial
=Siguiente => Next
=Saltar tutorial => Skip tutorial
=¡Sí, vamos! => Yes, let's go!
=¡A jugar! => Let's play!
=Teclado y botones => Keyboard and buttons
=Día => Day
=¡Misión cumplida! Ahora eres parte del equipo de Sojourner. => Mission accomplished! Now you're part of the Sojourner team.
=¡Hola! Soy Neptunito. Hoy tú y yo somos el equipo que maneja a Sojourner desde la Tierra. ¿Te enseño a jugar? => Hi! I'm Neptunito. Today you and I are the team that drives Sojourner from Earth. Shall I show you how to play?
=Este es Sojourner visto desde arriba. El triángulo rojo es su frente y el círculo amarillo de atrás es el APXS, el instrumento que analiza las rocas. => This is Sojourner seen from above. The red triangle is its front, and the yellow circle at the back is the APXS, the instrument that analyzes rocks.
=Esta es la roca que hay que analizar hoy. Truco: como el APXS va atrás, Sojourner tiene que llegar de espaldas a la roca, pegado a ella. => This is the rock to analyze today. Tip: since the APXS is at the back, Sojourner has to reach the rock backwards, right up against it.
=En el centro está el módulo Pathfinder. Sojourner solo puede moverse dentro del círculo punteado: su zona de trabajo de 12 m. => The Pathfinder module is in the center. Sojourner can only move inside the dotted circle: its 12 m work zone.
=Estos son tus mandos. Cada botón agrega una orden a tu plan. => These are your controls. Each button adds a command to your plan.
=Prueba: toca el botón «Girar derecha». => Try it: tap the "Turn right" button.
=✓ ¡Muy bien! La orden se guardó en tu programa. Sojourner todavía no se mueve: primero se planifica. => ✓ Well done! The command was saved in your program. Sojourner doesn't move yet: first you plan.
=Aquí se arma tu programa: caben hasta 12 órdenes. Si te equivocas, toca una orden para quitarla. => This is where you build your program: it holds up to 12 commands. If you make a mistake, tap a command to remove it.
=Ahora toca la orden que pusiste para quitarla. => Now tap the command you added to remove it.
=✓ ¡Perfecto! También puedes usar «Borrar última» o «Borrar todo». => ✓ Perfect! You can also use "Delete last" or "Delete all".
=Cuando tu plan esté listo, toca «Enviar a Marte». Antes de enviar, mira la línea punteada del mapa: muestra por dónde pasará Sojourner. => When your plan is ready, tap "Send to Mars". Before sending, check the dotted line on the map: it shows where Sojourner will go.
=¿Juegas en computadora? También puedes usar el teclado: las flechas para moverte, A para analizar y Enter para enviar. => Playing on a computer? You can also use the keyboard: the arrows to move, A to analyze and Enter to send.
=¡Listo, ya sabes lo necesario! Tu primera misión: analizar la roca Barnacle Bill. Si necesitas ayuda, toca «Ver tutorial» cuando quieras. => All set, you know what you need! Your first mission: analyze the rock Barnacle Bill. If you need help, tap "Watch tutorial" anytime.
=Día 1 => Day 1
=Día 2 => Day 2
=Día 3 => Day 3
=¡Yay, lo lograste con el mínimo de órdenes! ¡Eres un genio de la planificación! => Yay, you did it with the fewest commands! You're a planning genius!
=¡Increíble! Plan perfecto. ¡Estoy muy orgulloso de ti! => Amazing! A perfect plan. I'm so proud of you!
=¡Wow! Ni una orden de más. ¡Piensas como el equipo de control de una misión! => Wow! Not a single extra command. You think like a mission control team!
=¡Yay, lo lograste! Estoy muy orgulloso de ti. => Yay, you did it! I'm so proud of you.
=¡Bien hecho! Tu plan funcionó. ¿Te animas a hacerlo con menos órdenes? => Well done! Your plan worked. Want to try it with fewer commands?
=¡Lo lograste! Cada día planificas mejor. => You did it! You plan better every day.
=¡Lo lograste! Lo importante es que no te rendiste. ¡Estoy orgulloso de ti! => You did it! What matters is that you didn't give up. I'm proud of you!
=¡Misión cumplida! Cada intento te hizo mejor. ¡Sigue así! => Mission accomplished! Every try made you better. Keep it up!
=¡Yay, lo lograste! Practicar es el secreto de los grandes exploradores. => Yay, you did it! Practice is the secret of great explorers.
=¡No pasa nada! Equivocarse también es aprender. ¡Tú puedes! => It's okay! Making mistakes is part of learning. You can do it!
=Respira, revisa la línea punteada y vuelve a intentarlo. ¡Confío en ti! => Take a breath, check the dotted line and try again. I believe in you!
=¡Casi! Cada intento te acerca a la meta. => Almost! Every try gets you closer to the goal.
=Los errores son pistas: ahora ya sabes qué cambiar. ¡Vamos otra vez! => Mistakes are clues: now you know what to change. Let's go again!
=¡Allá van tus órdenes! Buen trabajo planificando. => There go your commands! Nice planning.
=¡Enviado! Veamos qué tan bien lo planeaste. => Sent! Let's see how well you planned it.
=¡Buen plan! Crucemos los dedos. => Good plan! Fingers crossed.
=Estoy muy orgulloso de ti: planificaste, te equivocaste, lo volviste a intentar y lo lograste. ¡Así trabajan los grandes exploradores! => I'm so proud of you: you planned, made mistakes, tried again and made it. That's how great explorers work!
